Title: Successful Login with Valid Credentials
Description: Verify that a user can log in successfully using a valid email address and password.
Preconditions: User account exists and is active; login page is accessible via app.vwo.com; HTTPS is active.
Test Data: Valid email: user@example.com; valid password: ValidPassword@123
Test Steps:
1. Open the VWO login page.
2. Enter the valid email address.
3. Enter the valid password.
4. Click the login button.
5. Wait for authentication response.
Expected Result: User is authenticated. The system transitions to the main dashboard or next authenticated state. No invalid credential error is shown. Loading indicator clears after success.

Title: Login Fails with Invalid Password
Description: Verify that an incorrect password is rejected with a clear error message.
Preconditions: User exists but password is incorrect; login page is open.
Test Data: Valid email: user@example.com; invalid password: WrongPassword@123
Test Steps:
1. Open the VWO login page.
2. Enter the valid email.
3. Enter an incorrect password.
4. Click the login button.
Expected Result: Authentication fails. User stays on the login page or error state. Clear actionable error message shown. No sensitive details are exposed.

Title: Email Format Validation
Description: Validate that invalid email format is rejected using field validation.
Test Steps:
1. Open the login page.
2. Enter invalid email format.
3. Trigger blur validation.
4. Enter a valid password.
5. Click login.
Expected Result: Email validation error is visible. User cannot proceed with invalid email data. Error message is clear and actionable.

Title: Empty Fields Submission
Description: Verify that empty email and password values are prevented from submission.
Test Steps:
1. Open the login page.
2. Leave email blank.
3. Leave password blank.
4. Click login button.
Expected Result: Submission is blocked. Validation errors shown for missing required fields. User is not authenticated.

Title: Forgot Password with Valid Email
Description: Verify the password reset workflow for a valid registered email address.
Preconditions: User is on login page; valid account email is known.
Test Steps:
1. Open login page.
2. Click Forgot Password.
3. Enter valid email.
4. Submit request.
Expected Result: Reset request is accepted. Recovery initiation works. User sees correct confirmation or next-step message. No sensitive account data is displayed.

Title: Forgot Password with Invalid Email
Description: Verify invalid or unregistered email is handled safely during reset flow.
Preconditions: User is on Forgot Password page.
Test Data: Invalid email: invalid@example.com or malformed email
Test Steps:
1. Open login page.
2. Click Forgot Password.
3. Enter invalid or unregistered email.
4. Submit request.
Expected Result: Request is rejected appropriately. User sees clear message. No sensitive account information is revealed.

Title: Remember Me Session Persistence
Description: Verify the Remember Me option persists the session.
Preconditions: User has valid credentials; login page is open.
Test Data: Valid email and password; Remember Me enabled
Test Steps:
1. Open login page.
2. Enter valid credentials.
3. Select Remember Me.
4. Log in.
5. Close and reopen session context.
Expected Result: Session remains available as configured. User can access authenticated area without re-entering credentials. Secure session handling is maintained.

Title: Session Timeout Handling
Description: Verify expired or timed-out session triggers sign-out or reauthentication.
Preconditions: User is authenticated; session timeout is configured.
Test Data: Authenticated session; timeout period configured by the system
Test Steps:
1. Log in successfully.
2. Wait for timeout period.
3. Attempt to access authenticated page.
Expected Result: User is logged out or reauthentication is required. Session expiry is clearly communicated. No unauthorized access is granted.

Title: Brute Force / Rate Limiting Protection
Description: Verify repeated failed login attempts are controlled by rate limiting or protection measures.
Preconditions: Login page is open; user account exists.
Test Data: Valid email: user@example.com; repeated invalid passwords
Test Steps:
1. Open login page.
2. Enter valid email.
3. Submit incorrect password repeatedly.
4. Continue until multiple attempts are triggered.
Expected Result: System enforces rate limiting or lockout behavior. User sees clear warning. Brute-force access attempts are blocked.

Title: Accessibility and Keyboard Navigation
Description: Verify login page supports keyboard navigation and screen-reader-friendly interaction.
Preconditions: Login page is loaded; keyboard navigation or accessibility tools are available.
Test Data: Valid user details if login flow is continued after navigation checks
Test Steps:
1. Open login page.
2. Use Tab key to move through form fields and controls.
3. Trigger actions using Enter.
4. Inspect labels and focus order.
Expected Result: All interactive elements are reachable via keyboard. Focus order is logical and visible. Labels and controls are usable with assistive technologies.

Title: Responsive Mobile Layout Validation
Description: Verify the login flow works on mobile devices and smaller screens.
Preconditions: Browser dev tools or mobile device is available.
Test Steps:
1. Open login page on mobile viewport or device.
2. Confirm inputs and buttons remain visible and aligned.
3. Attempt login with valid credentials.
4. Check touch usability.
Expected Result: Page is responsive and usable on mobile devices. Inputs remain readable and touch-friendly. Login flow works with no layout issues.

Title: Login Page Load Performance
Description: Verify the login page loads within the PRD performance target on standard connections.
Preconditions: Network conditions for performance validation are available.
Test Steps:
1. Open login page in browser.
2. Measure page load time.
3. Repeat under normal conditions.
Expected Result: Page loads within 2 seconds on standard connections. Interface appears without significant delay. Page remains responsive.

Title: Optional 2FA Support Validation
Description: Verify optional 2FA works correctly when enabled.
Preconditions: User account is configured for 2FA; secure environment is available.
Test Data: Valid login credentials and second-factor challenge
Test Steps:
1. Open login page.
2. Enter valid email and password.
3. Trigger 2FA flow.
4. Complete secondary authentication.
Expected Result: User is authenticated only after successful 2FA verification. Errors are clear and secure. Enhanced security requirements are satisfied.

Title: SSO Login Readiness Validation
Description: Verify enterprise SSO flows are accessible and consistent when configured.
Preconditions: SSO configuration is available in the environment.
Test Data: Enterprise user account and SSO provider configuration
Test Steps:
1. Open the enterprise login path.
2. Initiate login via SSO or identity provider.
3. Complete the enterprise-auth flow.
Expected Result: User can log in through supported SSO. No broken redirect or authentication failure occurs. Enterprise login requirements are satisfied.
